plan.notes: Official NMSU 2024-2025 Academic Catalog (archived edition), 'Criminal Justice - Bachelor of Criminal Justice', A Suggested Plan of Study for Students (Las Cruces campus). The catalog organizes this roadmap by academic YEAR (Freshman/Sophomore/Junior/Senior) with no official semester-by-semester sequence, so it is collected as a single requirements block per convention; courses are listed in catalog year order (Freshman, Sophomore, Junior, Senior years, 30 credits each at minimums). Roadmap assumes placement in MATH 1220G/1350G/2350G and ENGL 1110G; not a contract. Choice slots recorded at catalog minimum credit per convention (Area III/IV slot 3-4 recorded at 3; General Education Elective 3-4 recorded at 3). CJUS 300 may substitute for POLS 300, PSYC 3110, or SOCI 3150 per catalog note. Year totals 30/30/30/30 = 120, matching the catalog's 'Total Credits 120-122' at its minimum.
